cycle1.hypothesis: Prioritize the note view for semantic documents; exclude objectively contradicted or out-of-scope structured cards. Evaluate raw readers separately from code controls.

cycle2.hypothesis: Cycle1 errors were dominated by known fields declared missing. Test dynamic missing_fields enums against the same checklist, without changing factual inputs, semantic states, citation requirements or objective guards.
cycle2.supersedes: Contrastive examples were planned but not executed. This is a registered replacement before cycle2 inference, within the original 32-call quota; cycle1 and its original design preserved.
cycle2.attribution: Constrained-output improvement is code, not independent model inference.

cycle3.purpose: Full 32-case development confirmation of selected candidates, maximum two cards/case/model.

generation.prompt: Explain in Portuguese, at most two sentences/60 words, why the documented explanation fits these observed facts and which uncertainty the documented verification would clarify. Do not invent, repeat or paraphrase procedures, infer a cause or turn unknown into absence. No other text.
generation.role: separate generation after accepted selection; not part of classification

reference_limits: Assistant-authored cases/gold. Grouped A/B variants. Code-derived conditions are not credited as independent model intelligence.
